seo.metaTitle: Marafa: Hell's Kitchen | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Red sandstone cliffs near Malindi. 6 hours small-group tour in Marafa, Kenya.

title: Kilifi Creek and Mnarani Ruins
summary: Kilifi sits on a deep tidal creek crossed by a long bridge. You climb to the Mnarani ruins, a 14th-century mosque and tombs on the headland, swim in the creek from a jetty and eat grilled fish at a creekside restaurant while dhows slide past.

seo.metaTitle: Kilifi Creek and Mnarani Ruins | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Swim, hike, wander ruins. 6 hours small-group tour in Kilifi, Kenya.

title: Diani's Sacred Forest
summary: Kaya Kinondo is a sacred forest of the Digo people. A community guide explains the rules for entering and the history of the forest, and you walk the trail in respectful dress.

seo.metaTitle: Diani's Sacred Forest | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Kaya Kinondo, with permission. 4 hours small-group tour in Diani, Kenya.

title: Wasini Island and Dolphins
summary: A dhow takes you from Shimoni to Wasini Island, where you snorkel in Kisite-Mpunguti Marine Park and look for dolphins. Lunch is a seafood spread on the island.

seo.metaTitle: Wasini Island and Dolphins | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Boat out, snorkel, lunch. 8 hours small-group tour in Wasini, Kenya.

title: Shimba Hills: Sable Antelope Country
summary: Shimba Hills is the only place in Kenya where you can see sable antelope, with their curved horns and glossy black coats. A ranger drives you across grassland and forest, then walks you down to Sheldrick Falls for a swim and a picnic.

seo.metaTitle: Shimba Hills: Sable Antelope Country | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: A coastal forest with rare antelope. 7 hours small-group tour in Shimba Hills, Kenya.

title: Tsavo East: Red Elephants
summary: Tsavo East is a huge park where elephants roll in red dust and look rust-coloured. You drive along the Galana River and watch herds come down to drink.

seo.metaTitle: Tsavo East: Red Elephants | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Dust that stains them rust. 3 days small-group tour in Tsavo East, Kenya.

title: Mzima Springs: Clear Water, Hippos
summary: Mzima Springs gushes out of volcanic rock and feeds a pipeline to Mombasa. An underwater viewing chamber lets you watch hippos moving along the bottom of clear pools, and a short trail follows the pools through palms and fig trees.

seo.metaTitle: Mzima Springs: Clear Water, Hippos | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: A spring that feeds Mombasa. 2 days small-group tour in Tsavo West, Kenya.

title: Chyulu Hills: Lava Tubes and Open Sky
summary: The Chyulu Hills formed from lava flows, and tunnels run beneath the grass. A ranger takes you into Leviathan Cave, one of the longest lava tubes in the world, with torches and helmets. Above ground, the open hills face Kilimanjaro.

seo.metaTitle: Chyulu Hills: Lava Tubes and Open Sky | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Walk inside a volcano**'**s old plumbing. 2 days small-group tour in Chyulu Hills, Kenya.

title: Amboseli at Dawn
summary: Amboseli is known for big elephant herds with Kilimanjaro behind them. We time the drives for early morning when the mountain is clear, and climb Observation Hill for the full view.

seo.metaTitle: Amboseli at Dawn | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Elephants with Kilimanjaro. 3 days small-group tour in Amboseli, Kenya.

title: Mara River Crossing Watch
summary: From roughly July to October, wildebeest cross the Mara River in huge numbers. You wait with a guide at known crossing points and watch the herds decide. Timing varies yearly.

seo.metaTitle: Mara River Crossing Watch | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Wildebeest at the water**'**s edge. 3 days small-group tour in Maasai Mara, Kenya.

title: Mara at Sunrise by Balloon
summary: A hot air balloon lifts off at dawn and drifts over the Mara plains, followed by a champagne bush breakfast. You see herds from above in soft light.

seo.metaTitle: Mara at Sunrise by Balloon | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Drift over the plains. 4 hours small-group tour in Maasai Mara, Kenya.

title: Naboisho Walking Safari
summary: Naboisho is a conservancy owned by Maasai landowners next to the Mara. A Maasai guide leads you on foot, reads tracks and dung, and explains how conservancy lease payments reach families. You return for a bush lunch.

seo.metaTitle: Naboisho Walking Safari | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Tracks on foot in a conservancy. 3 days small-group tour in Maasai Mara, Kenya.

title: Karura Forest Waterfall Loop
summary: Karura Forest is a large urban forest with waterfalls, a cave once used by Mau Mau fighters and cycling trails. We walk or cycle a loop to the main waterfall, passing bamboo groves and troops of monkeys.

seo.metaTitle: Karura Forest Waterfall Loop | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Forest in the city. 4 hours small-group tour in Nairobi, Kenya.

title: Ngong Hills Ridge Walk
summary: The Ngong Hills run along the edge of the Rift Valley, with views over Nairobi and the plains. A ranger-led hike takes you along the ridge past wind turbines.

seo.metaTitle: Ngong Hills Ridge Walk | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Seven peaks and a rift view. 5 hours small-group tour in Ngong, Kenya.

title: Kibera Walk With a Resident Guide
summary: Kibera is one of Africa's largest informal settlements. A resident guide leads a respectful walk through small businesses, a school and a community project, and part of the fee goes directly to local initiatives.

seo.metaTitle: Kibera Walk With a Resident Guide | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Hear it from the people who live there. 3 hours small-group tour in Nairobi, Kenya.

title: Bomas of Kenya: Dance Drums in One Place
summary: Bomas of Kenya brings together homesteads from many Kenyan communities in one park. A guide walks you through each one, explaining the thatch, the layout and the customs, then the afternoon dance troupe performs songs from several regions.

seo.metaTitle: Bomas of Kenya: Dance Drums in One Place | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: A tribe a hop. 3 hours small-group tour in Nairobi, Kenya.

title: Nairobi Railway Museum: The Lunatic Express
summary: The railway built from Mombasa to Uganda shaped modern Kenya and earned the nickname Lunatic Express. The museum holds steam locomotives, old carriages and archives, and a guide tells the stories of the workers who built the line and the Tsavo lions that attacked them.

seo.metaTitle: Nairobi Railway Museum: The Lunatic Express | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Steam, history and old tickets. 3 hours small-group tour in Nairobi, Kenya.

title: Kenya National Museum: Lucy's Neighbours
summary: The National Museum holds a replica of the Turkana Boy skeleton, early human fossils and an enormous bird collection. A guide takes you to the pieces that matter, then through the snake park and botanical garden beside it.

seo.metaTitle: Kenya National Museum: Lucy's Neighbours | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Fossils, birds and the Kenyan story. 3 hours small-group tour in Nairobi, Kenya.

title: Fourteen Falls Picnic
summary: Fourteen Falls on the Athi River spreads wide across a rock shelf, and the pool at the bottom is safe for swimming in the dry season. We picnic on the bank and a local guide tells stories of flash floods and fishermen.

seo.metaTitle: Fourteen Falls Picnic | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Wide, shallow, swimmable. 6 hours small-group tour in Thika, Kenya.

title: Meru National Park: Born Free Ground
summary: Meru National Park is where Joy Adamson released Elsa the lioness. A ranger drives you through palm-dotted plains, past her old camp site, and along the Tana River, with elephants, giraffe and reticulated zebra along the way.

seo.metaTitle: Meru National Park: Born Free Ground | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Where Elsa was released. 3 days small-group tour in Meru, Kenya.

title: Taita Hills Cloud Forest
summary: The Taita Hills are an isolated range of cloud forest rising from dry plains, home to the endangered Taita thrush. A local guide leads a walk from Wundanyi through forest fragments, explaining how farmers protect the remaining trees.

seo.metaTitle: Taita Hills Cloud Forest | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Mist, birds and mission hills. 2 days small-group tour in Taita Hills, Kenya.

title: Lake Elementaita and the Flamingo Margin
summary: Lake Elementaita is a shallow soda lake ringed by hills, with pelicans and flamingos along the shore. You walk the lake edge, visit Soysambu Conservancy and look for giraffe and zebra grazing near the water.

seo.metaTitle: Lake Elementaita and the Flamingo Margin | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: A UNESCO soda lake. 5 hours small-group tour in Elementaita, Kenya.

title: Kenya Coast Road Trip: Mombasa to Lamu
summary: Four days along the coast road: Gedi ruins, a Malindi stop, sunset at Marafa and the ferry across to Lamu. Each stop has a local guide, and there's room for beach time in between.

seo.metaTitle: Kenya Coast Road Trip: Mombasa to Lamu | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Slow coast, many stops. 4 days small-group tour in Lamu, Kenya.

title: Vasco da Gama Pillar and Malindi Old Town
summary: Malindi is where Vasco da Gama met Swahili rulers in 1498 and left a stone pillar on the headland. A guide walks you from the pillar through the old town, the fish market and a small Portuguese chapel.

seo.metaTitle: Vasco da Gama Pillar and Malindi Old Town | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: A pillar from 1498. 3 hours small-group tour in Malindi, Kenya.

title: Lake Naivasha Fish Eagle Boat
summary: A small boat takes you out on Lake Naivasha at dawn. The boatman throws fish into the water and calls the fish eagles down with a whistle, and you drift past hippos and papyrus beds.

seo.metaTitle: Lake Naivasha Fish Eagle Boat | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Throw a fish, watch it caught. 3 hours small-group tour in Naivasha, Kenya.

title: Mount Kenya Foothills by Horse
summary: From Nanyuki you ride horses along ranch tracks and through forest on the lower slopes of Mount Kenya. A groom matches you to a calm horse, and lunch is a picnic by a stream.

seo.metaTitle: Mount Kenya Foothills by Horse | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Ride through coffee and forest. 5 hours small-group tour in Nanyuki, Kenya.

title: Equator Line Stop in Nanyuki
summary: A short stop at the equator marker north of Nanyuki, where a guide shows water draining in opposite directions on either side of the line. It's a quick, goofy photo stop on the road to Mount Kenya.

seo.metaTitle: Equator Line Stop in Nanyuki | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Water goes which way. 2 hours small-group tour in Nanyuki, Kenya.

title: Kakamega After Dark: Night Walk for Frogs and Bush Babies
summary: Kakamega changes completely after sunset. A forest guide leads a slow night walk with red-filtered torches, pointing out chameleons asleep on twigs, tree frogs calling from the stream edge and bush babies moving in the canopy. Boots and long sleeves are essential.

seo.metaTitle: Kakamega After Dark: Night Walk for Frogs and Bush Babies | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Torches, tree frogs, and a very quiet forest. 3 hours small-group tour in Kakamega, Kenya.

title: Ruma National Park: Roan Antelope and Almost Nobody
summary: Ruma National Park in Homa Bay County is the only place in Kenya to see roan antelope, along with Jackson's hartebeest and Rothschild's giraffe. Visitor numbers are low, so you often drive for hours without seeing another vehicle.

seo.metaTitle: Ruma National Park: Roan Antelope and Almost Nobody | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Kenya**'**s quiet western reserve. 2 days small-group tour in Homa Bay, Kenya.

title: Kilifi Baobab Walk
summary: Baobab trees in coastal Kenya can be over a thousand years old and many are tied up with local stories and burial customs. A Mijikenda guide walks you through a grove, explains how people use the fruit and bark and tastes powdery baobab pulp.

seo.metaTitle: Kilifi Baobab Walk | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Ancient trees on the coast. 4 hours small-group tour in Kilifi, Kenya.

title: Lake Magadi Soda Works
summary: Lake Magadi is a soda lake in the southern Rift Valley, covered with white crust and ringed with hot springs. A tour of the soda ash works explains the industry, and flamingos wade in the shallows.

seo.metaTitle: Lake Magadi Soda Works | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: White crust, pink water. 8 hours small-group tour in Magadi, Kenya.

title: Kitengela Glass: Bottles Reborn
summary: Kitengela Glass turns recycled bottles into vases, mosaics and sculptures. You watch glassblowers at work in the studio, wander a garden of glass art and make your own small piece to take home.

seo.metaTitle: Kitengela Glass: Bottles Reborn | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Melted bottles, bright art. 4 hours small-group tour in Kitengela, Kenya.

title: Mombasa Mamba Village Crocodiles
summary: Mamba Village is a crocodile farm north of Mombasa. A keeper explains crocodile behaviour, there's a feeding show, and the nature trail winds past ostriches and a small butterfly house.

seo.metaTitle: Mombasa Mamba Village Crocodiles | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Feeding time. 3 hours small-group tour in Mombasa, Kenya.

title: Mount Suswa Caves
summary: Mount Suswa is a dormant volcano with a double crater and extensive lava caves. A Maasai guide leads you into the caves, and you camp near the crater.

seo.metaTitle: Mount Suswa Caves | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Volcano with a hole in it. 2 days small-group tour in Suswa, Kenya.

title: Oloololo Escarpment Sundowner
summary: The Oloololo Escarpment overlooks the Mara Triangle. We drive up in the late afternoon, set up a sundowner on the ridge and watch the plains turn gold below.

seo.metaTitle: Oloololo Escarpment Sundowner | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Look down on the Mara. 3 hours small-group tour in Maasai Mara, Kenya.

title: Machakos Peoples' Park and Kamba Carvings
summary: The Kamba are known for wood carving, and Wamunyu is the centre of the trade. You watch figures emerge from logs, try a few strokes with an adze and stop at Machakos Peoples' Park for lunch.

seo.metaTitle: Machakos Peoples' Park and Kamba Carvings | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: Wood and stone. 5 hours small-group tour in Machakos, Kenya.

title: Nyeri and Baden-Powell's Last Address
summary: Robert Baden-Powell, founder of the Scout movement, spent his final years at Paxtu cottage in Nyeri and is buried there, with Mount Kenya behind the grave. A local historian tells the story and takes you around Nyeri town.

seo.metaTitle: Nyeri and Baden-Powell's Last Address | Kenya
seo.metaDescription: The Scouting founder retired in Kenya. 4 hours small-group tour in Nyeri, Kenya.

title: Materuni Falls, Then Coffee in a Hand-Turned Mortar
summary: Materuni is a Chagga village on the lower slopes of Kilimanjaro. You hike through banana groves to a 70-metre waterfall, then climb back to a family farm where coffee is roasted over a fire, pounded by hand and served black.

seo.metaTitle: Materuni Falls, Then Coffee in a Hand-Turned Mortar | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Hike down, drink up. 6 hours small-group tour in Moshi, Tanzania.

title: Kilimanjaro by Marangu: Hut to Hut
summary: The Marangu Route is the only Kilimanjaro trail with sleeping huts, so you skip the tents. Five nights, a guide and a cook, and a summit push before dawn to Uhuru Peak.

seo.metaTitle: Kilimanjaro by Marangu: Hut to Hut | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: The gentle route up. 6 days small-group tour in Moshi, Tanzania.

title: Lemosho, Taken Slowly
summary: Eight days on the western approach lets your body catch up with the altitude. You walk from rainforest across the Shira Plateau, spend a night near Lava Tower and scramble up the Barranco Wall before the final summit push. Guides, porters and a cook look after camp.

seo.metaTitle: Lemosho, Taken Slowly | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Slow ascent, better odds. 8 days small-group tour in Kilimanjaro, Tanzania.

title: Mount Meru: Kilimanjaro's Neighbour
summary: Mount Meru is the fifth-highest mountain in Africa and a good warm-up for Kilimanjaro. You climb with an armed ranger through Arusha National Park, spotting buffalo and giraffe on the first day.

seo.metaTitle: Mount Meru: Kilimanjaro's Neighbour | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Steep, quiet and brilliant. 4 days small-group tour in Arusha, Tanzania.

title: Walk the Wild Side of Arusha National Park
summary: Arusha National Park is small, but it packs in forest, crater and lakes. An armed ranger walks you past giraffe and buffalo, you look for black-and-white colobus in the canopy and finish with a paddle on Small Momella Lake.

seo.metaTitle: Walk the Wild Side of Arusha National Park | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Giraffe, colobus and a crater. 6 hours small-group tour in Arusha, Tanzania.

title: Dugout at Duluti
summary: Lake Duluti sits in a crater on Arusha's edge, ringed by forest. You paddle out in a dugout canoe at first light, watch kingfishers hunt along the shore and spot monitor lizards sunning on the branches before the day heats up.

seo.metaTitle: Dugout at Duluti | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Quiet crater lake near town. 3 hours small-group tour in Arusha, Tanzania.

title: Down Into the Bowl: Ngorongoro Crater
summary: Ngorongoro is a collapsed volcano whose floor holds lions, hyenas, hippos and some of the last black rhinos in Tanzania. You descend at dawn, drive through the Lerai forest and picnic by the Ngoitokitok springs while hippos wallow below.

seo.metaTitle: Down Into the Bowl: Ngorongoro Crater | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: An old volcano, packed with animals. 2 days small-group tour in Ngorongoro, Tanzania.

title: Empakaai: The Crater Nobody Queues For
summary: Empakaai is a deep caldera north of Ngorongoro with a blue-green lake and flamingos along the shore. A ranger leads the steep walk down, and on clear days Ol Doinyo Lengai smokes in the distance behind the rim.

seo.metaTitle: Empakaai: The Crater Nobody Queues For | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A flamingo lake in a hole. 8 hours small-group tour in Ngorongoro, Tanzania.

title: Olduvai Gorge: Where the Leakeys Dug
summary: Louis and Mary Leakey found early human remains here, including a skull in 1959. The small museum on the rim explains the finds, and a guide walks the gorge to the layers where stone tools and bones were uncovered.

seo.metaTitle: Olduvai Gorge: Where the Leakeys Dug | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: The ground where early humans lived. 4 hours small-group tour in Olduvai, Tanzania.

title: Serengeti Migration Watch
summary: The wildebeest migration moves in a loop through the Serengeti. We position you where the herds are at your travel date, with game drives and a night in a tented camp. Locations shift each year.

seo.metaTitle: Serengeti Migration Watch | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Follow the herds. 4 days small-group tour in Serengeti, Tanzania.

title: Serengeti From Above
summary: Before sunrise the balloon crew inflates the envelope and you lift off over the Serengeti plains. You drift above herds and riverbeds for about an hour, then land for a champagne breakfast set up on a table in the bush.

seo.metaTitle: Serengeti From Above | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Float above the plains. 4 hours small-group tour in Serengeti, Tanzania.

title: Tarangire's Giants: Baobabs and Elephants
summary: Tarangire's ancient baobabs rise above dry grass, and elephant herds come to the river in the dry season. You drive the river loop with a guide, look for tree-climbing pythons and picnic beneath a baobab with a view of the swamp.

seo.metaTitle: Tarangire's Giants: Baobabs and Elephants | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: The park with the big trees. 2 days small-group tour in Tarangire, Tanzania.

title: Cats in the Branches of Lake Manyara
summary: Manyara's lions sometimes climb acacia trees to escape the heat and flies. The park also has a groundwater forest with baboons and blue monkeys, hippo pools and flamingo flocks, all packed into a single day.

seo.metaTitle: Cats in the Branches of Lake Manyara | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A cat that sleeps in the branches. 8 hours small-group tour in Lake Manyara, Tanzania.

title: Mto wa Mbu: Banana Beer and a Walk
summary: Mto wa Mbu is a mix of more than 100 ethnic groups. You walk the village with a local guide, taste banana beer, visit a rice farm and see woodcarvers.

seo.metaTitle: Mto wa Mbu: Banana Beer and a Walk | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A cultural tourism programme. 5 hours small-group tour in Mto wa Mbu, Tanzania.

title: Lake Natron and the Mountain of God
summary: Natron is a red-tinged salt lake where flamingos breed, and Ol Doinyo Lengai, the Maasai 'Mountain of God', rises beside it. A guide arranges the midnight climb up the volcano and a cooling dip in Engare Sero Gorge afterwards.

seo.metaTitle: Lake Natron and the Mountain of God | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Flamingo breeding ground, active volcano. 3 days small-group tour in Lake Natron, Tanzania.

title: Engare Sero: Wade Up the Canyon
summary: At Lake Natron's southern end, a stream cuts through a narrow gorge and ends at a waterfall with a pool. A Maasai guide leads you upstream, wading in warm water between canyon walls and pointing out birds and baboons along the way.

seo.metaTitle: Engare Sero: Wade Up the Canyon | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Wade through a canyon. 5 hours small-group tour in Lake Natron, Tanzania.

title: Engaruka: A Farming Town Lost in the Rift
summary: Engaruka is a field of stone terraces and irrigation channels abandoned a few centuries ago. A local guide explains the theories about who farmed here and why they left, and walks you up to the viewpoint beneath the escarpment.

seo.metaTitle: Engaruka: A Farming Town Lost in the Rift | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Stone terraces nobody explains well. 5 hours small-group tour in Engaruka, Tanzania.

title: Hunters at Lake Eyasi
summary: The Hadzabe live around Lake Eyasi and hunt with bows and arrows. A community-run morning takes you out with a small group at dawn, with agreed fees and photo rules, and a stop at a Datoga blacksmith's forge afterwards.

seo.metaTitle: Hunters at Lake Eyasi | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Hunting and gathering, in 2020s Tanzania. 2 days small-group tour in Lake Eyasi, Tanzania.

title: Lushoto's Switchbacks and Cool Air
summary: The road to Lushoto climbs in hairpins into the Usambara Mountains. You hike to the Irente viewpoint, walk a stretch of Magamba rainforest, visit a vegetable farm and eat lunch at a mission-run farm shop.

seo.metaTitle: Lushoto's Switchbacks and Cool Air | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Hairpin roads and cool air. 3 days small-group tour in Lushoto, Tanzania.

title: Pare Mountain Strolls
summary: The Pare Mountains rise from dry plains and hold cool, green villages with banana farms and stone churches. A local guide walks you between settlements and lunch is cooked in a family home.

seo.metaTitle: Pare Mountain Strolls | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A quieter highland. 2 days small-group tour in Pare, Tanzania.

title: Sanje Falls and Red Colobus
summary: Udzungwa's Sanje Falls drops about 170 metres through forest. A ranger leads the hike, you search for Iringa red colobus and Sanje mangabeys along the way and swim in the pool at the bottom.

seo.metaTitle: Sanje Falls and Red Colobus | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Primates and a 170-metre drop. 2 days small-group tour in Udzungwa, Tanzania.

title: Mikumi: Safari on the Dar Highway
summary: Mikumi National Park sits beside the road from Dar es Salaam, so wildlife is accessible even on a short trip. You drive the Mkata floodplain looking for giraffe, buffalo and lions, with a picnic by the hippo pool.

seo.metaTitle: Mikumi: Safari on the Dar Highway | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Lions on the Dar road. 2 days small-group tour in Mikumi, Tanzania.

title: Rufiji by Boat: Hippos at Eye Level
summary: Nyerere National Park, formerly Selous, runs along the Rufiji River. A boat safari glides past hippo pods, crocodiles and elephants drinking at the bank, and a walking safari with a ranger follows after lunch.

seo.metaTitle: Rufiji by Boat: Hippos at Eye Level | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Hippos and crocs on the water. 3 days small-group tour in Nyerere National Park, Tanzania.

title: Ruaha's Big Skies
summary: Ruaha is Tanzania's largest national park and sees few visitors. You drive along the Great Ruaha River, pass baobab-studded hills, look for lions and greater kudu and sleep in a tented camp under the stars.

seo.metaTitle: Ruaha's Big Skies | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A southern park, few vehicles. 4 days small-group tour in Ruaha, Tanzania.

title: Katavi: Where Hippos Pile Up
summary: In the dry season, hundreds of hippos crowd into the shrinking pools of the Katuma River at Katavi. You fly in, drive the plains with a ranger and watch buffalo herds and crocodiles at the water's edge.

seo.metaTitle: Katavi: Where Hippos Pile Up | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Wildest park in the west. 4 days small-group tour in Katavi, Tanzania.

title: Mahale: Chimps at the Lake's Edge
summary: Mahale is reached only by boat across Lake Tanganyika. Trackers lead you into the mountain forest to find a habituated chimp group, and the afternoon ends with a swim from a white beach.

seo.metaTitle: Mahale: Chimps at the Lake's Edge | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Trek through Lake Tanganyika forest. 4 days small-group tour in Mahale, Tanzania.

title: Gombe: Following Jane Goodall's Steps
summary: Jane Goodall began her chimpanzee research here in 1960. You arrive by boat, walk steep forest trails with a ranger, find chimps grooming and feeding and swim at the Kakombe Waterfall.

seo.metaTitle: Gombe: Following Jane Goodall's Steps | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Stream, steep and primates. 2 days small-group tour in Gombe, Tanzania.

title: Ujiji: The Place of the Famous Greeting
summary: At Ujiji, Henry Stanley found David Livingstone in 1871. A local historian takes you to the memorial and the old mango tree site, then to the harbour where dhows still tie up and fish are sold.

seo.metaTitle: Ujiji: The Place of the Famous Greeting | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: The meeting place. 5 hours small-group tour in Ujiji, Tanzania.

title: Kigoma Lamplight Fishing
summary: After sunset the fishermen of Kigoma set out on Lake Tanganyika with lamps to attract sardines. You join them in a boat, watch the nets go down and eat the fresh catch grilled on the shore.

seo.metaTitle: Kigoma Lamplight Fishing | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Fishing boats in orange light. 3 hours small-group tour in Kigoma, Tanzania.

title: Village Museum Dar: Houses of Many Peoples
summary: Dar es Salaam's Village Museum has full-size houses from different Tanzanian communities, each built by craftsmen from that group. A guide explains the building styles, and on some afternoons dancers perform on the lawn.

seo.metaTitle: Village Museum Dar: Houses of Many Peoples | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Houses from across Tanzania. 3 hours small-group tour in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

title: Kivukoni at Dawn: Fish, Ice and Haggling
summary: The Kivukoni fish market starts before sunrise as dhows and boats land their catch. You watch the auction, see octopus and tuna sold, and eat grilled fish with chili sauce and chapati at a market stall.

seo.metaTitle: Kivukoni at Dawn: Fish, Ice and Haggling | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Auction, noise and ice. 3 hours small-group tour in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

title: Kariakoo Unwrapped
summary: Kariakoo is the commercial heart of Dar es Salaam, a district of stacked shops, wholesalers and street hawkers. A local guide helps you through the crush, shows where to buy kanga cloth and spices and picks a stall for lunch.

seo.metaTitle: Kariakoo Unwrapped | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A district that runs on trade. 4 hours small-group tour in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

title: Bongoyo: Snorkel Day Near the City
summary: A boat from Msasani takes you to Bongoyo Island Marine Reserve, a short ride from Dar's skyline. You snorkel the reef, walk the nature trail and eat grilled fish at a beach shack.

seo.metaTitle: Bongoyo: Snorkel Day Near the City | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Snorkel off a nature reserve. 6 hours small-group tour in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

title: Kunduchi: The Ruins Under the Palms
summary: North of Dar, Kunduchi holds the ruins of a Swahili mosque and pillar tombs on the coast. A guide explains how the settlement connected to the Indian Ocean trade and why it faded.

seo.metaTitle: Kunduchi: The Ruins Under the Palms | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Mosque and tombs by the sea. 3 hours small-group tour in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

title: Bagamoyo: Where the Caravans Ended
summary: Bagamoyo was the end of the caravan route from the interior and a major slave and ivory port. A guide takes you through the old town, the Kaole ruins and the Catholic mission museum, telling the story with care.

seo.metaTitle: Bagamoyo: Where the Caravans Ended | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Where the slave route met the sea. 8 hours small-group tour in Bagamoyo, Tanzania.

title: Saadani: Safari With a Sea View
summary: Saadani is the one national park in East Africa that meets the ocean. You drive for giraffe and buffalo, take a boat up the Wami River for hippos and crocodiles and end the day on the beach.

seo.metaTitle: Saadani: Safari With a Sea View | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Elephants on the beach. 2 days small-group tour in Saadani, Tanzania.

title: Kilwa Kisiwani: A Medieval Sultanate by Dhow
summary: Kilwa Kisiwani was a wealthy trading city in the 13th and 14th centuries. A dhow crosses from Kilwa Masoko, and a guide walks you through the Great Mosque, the Husuni Kubwa palace and the old fort.

seo.metaTitle: Kilwa Kisiwani: A Medieval Sultanate by Dhow | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A medieval sultanate. 2 days small-group tour in Kilwa, Tanzania.

title: Mafia Island: Swimming With Whale Sharks
summary: From roughly October to March, whale sharks feed in the waters off Mafia Island. A boat takes you out with a guide and spotters, and you slip in with mask and snorkel to swim beside them. Sightings aren't guaranteed.

seo.metaTitle: Mafia Island: Swimming With Whale Sharks | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Swim with the biggest fish. 3 days small-group tour in Mafia Island, Tanzania.

title: Chole: Ruins, Bats and Baobabs
summary: Chole Island sits in Mafia's bay and holds a ruined Swahili town with a bat colony. A community guide leads you among the baobabs and old walls, and the village serves a seafood lunch.

seo.metaTitle: Chole: Ruins, Bats and Baobabs | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Island with bats and ruins. 6 hours small-group tour in Mafia Island, Tanzania.

title: Pemba and the Smell of Cloves
summary: Pemba produces much of the world's cloves. You visit a farm, watch cloves being picked and dried, walk the Ngezi forest to see rare flying foxes and look at the ruins at Ras Mkumbuu.

seo.metaTitle: Pemba and the Smell of Cloves | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Cloves, forest and quiet. 3 days small-group tour in Pemba, Tanzania.

title: Chumbe: A Reef That Someone Protected
summary: Chumbe Island is a private marine reserve with a coral reef, a forest and a lighthouse. A ranger guides you on a snorkel and a forest walk where giant coconut crabs live in the trees.

seo.metaTitle: Chumbe: A Reef That Someone Protected | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A reef sanctuary. 8 hours small-group tour in Chumbe, Tanzania.

title: Giant Tortoises on Changuu
summary: Changuu, or Prison Island, was built as a prison that never held prisoners. Today it houses giant Aldabra tortoises, some over a century old. A guide explains the island's history and you snorkel the nearby reef.

seo.metaTitle: Giant Tortoises on Changuu | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Aldabra tortoises and old cells. 4 hours small-group tour in Zanzibar, Tanzania.

title: Nungwi Dhow Builders
summary: In Nungwi, craftsmen build wooden dhows by eye, without plans, using hand tools passed down through families. You watch a shipwright shape ribs and planks and hear how long a boat takes to build.

seo.metaTitle: Nungwi Dhow Builders | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Boats built by hand. 3 hours small-group tour in Nungwi, Tanzania.

title: Mnemba Atoll Snorkel and Dolphins
summary: Mnemba is a marine reserve off Zanzibar's northeast coast with clear water and coral. A boat takes you out, and dolphins often appear on the way. You snorkel the reef in small groups.

seo.metaTitle: Mnemba Atoll Snorkel and Dolphins | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Clear water, reef fish. 6 hours small-group tour in Zanzibar, Tanzania.

title: Jambiani's Seaweed Women
summary: At low tide the women of Jambiani wade out to tend seaweed farms. You wade out with them, learn how seaweed is planted and harvested and watch it dry on the sand, then hear how prices affect the village.

seo.metaTitle: Jambiani's Seaweed Women | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Women of the tide. 4 hours small-group tour in Jambiani, Tanzania.

title: Paje: Strap In and Kite
summary: Paje has strong, steady winds and warm shallow water, which is ideal for learning kitesurfing. A local instructor teaches the basics on land first, then helps you into the water.

seo.metaTitle: Paje: Strap In and Kite | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Wind and shallow water. 3 hours small-group tour in Paje, Tanzania.

title: Kizimkazi Dolphin Dawn
summary: Kizimkazi on Zanzibar's south coast is known for bottlenose dolphins. Operators take small groups out early, and a village guide takes you to Kizimkazi's old mosque, one of the oldest in East Africa.

seo.metaTitle: Kizimkazi Dolphin Dawn | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Boat out with the pods. 4 hours small-group tour in Kizimkazi, Tanzania.

title: Kidichi: A Sultan's Bath House
summary: Kidichi's Persian baths were built in the 1850s for the Sultan's wife. A guide explains the plumbing, the arches and the story of the Omani rulers, and a nearby spice plantation adds a short walk.

seo.metaTitle: Kidichi: A Sultan's Bath House | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Sultan**'**s stone bathhouse. 3 hours small-group tour in Zanzibar, Tanzania.

title: Mangapwani: The Cave Where People Were Hidden
summary: The Mangapwani slave chamber is a coral cave where captives were hidden after the trade was banned. A guide tells the story with care, and there's time to sit by the sea afterwards.

seo.metaTitle: Mangapwani: The Cave Where People Were Hidden | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A hidden cave. 3 hours small-group tour in Zanzibar, Tanzania.

title: Isimila: Pillars and Stone Axes
summary: Isimila is a dry gully of tall sandstone pillars where archaeologists found hundreds of stone tools about 60,000 years old. A guide walks you through the site and explains how the tools were made.

seo.metaTitle: Isimila: Pillars and Stone Axes | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Hand axes in the dust. 4 hours small-group tour in Iringa, Tanzania.

title: Kitulo: The Plateau of Flowers
summary: Kitulo Plateau is covered in orchids and wildflowers between November and April. You hike with a ranger across open meadows at high altitude and learn the names and uses of the plants.

seo.metaTitle: Kitulo: The Plateau of Flowers | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A meadow of orchids. 2 days small-group tour in Kitulo, Tanzania.

title: Ngozi: A Lake in a Volcano
summary: Ngozi is a crater lake near Mbeya, reached by a steep hike through forest. At the rim the lake lies deep below, and a local guide tells stories about the water and the volcano.

seo.metaTitle: Ngozi: A Lake in a Volcano | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A lake inside a volcano. 6 hours small-group tour in Mbeya, Tanzania.

title: Mwanza and the Balancing Rock
summary: Mwanza is built on granite boulders beside Lake Victoria, and Bismarck Rock stands in the water like a stack of eggs. You take a boat past the rock, visit the waterfront and eat grilled tilapia.

seo.metaTitle: Mwanza and the Balancing Rock | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Rock on a lake. 4 hours small-group tour in Mwanza, Tanzania.

title: Saanane: A National Park on an Island
summary: Saanane Island is Tanzania's smallest national park, with rock hyrax, impala and vervet monkeys. A boat takes you from Mwanza and a ranger leads a walk around the island.

seo.metaTitle: Saanane: A National Park on an Island | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A city park on an island. 5 hours small-group tour in Mwanza, Tanzania.

title: Bujora: Sukuma Drums and Dancers
summary: Bujora's museum has a drum shrine, Sukuma houses and a traditional dance troupe. A guide explains Sukuma customs and the dancers perform the famous snake and bird dances, with drummers beating out the rhythm.

seo.metaTitle: Bujora: Sukuma Drums and Dancers | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Dance and drums. 4 hours small-group tour in Mwanza, Tanzania.

title: Amboni Caves, Torch in Hand
summary: The Amboni Caves are a limestone system near Tanga. A guide leads you in with torches, points out formations and bat colonies and tells local legends about the caves.

seo.metaTitle: Amboni Caves, Torch in Hand | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Limestone chambers. 4 hours small-group tour in Tanga, Tanzania.

title: Pangani: A Sleepy Port with Old Secrets
summary: Pangani is a quiet river port with old German buildings and a long trading history. You walk the old town and end with a cruise on the river through mangroves.

seo.metaTitle: Pangani: A Sleepy Port with Old Secrets | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Colonial buildings and a river mouth. 6 hours small-group tour in Pangani, Tanzania.

title: Dodoma Wine Country
summary: Dodoma is Tanzania's wine region, with vineyards on dry plains. You tour a winery, taste local reds and whites made from Chenin Blanc and Makutupora grapes and have lunch among the vines.

seo.metaTitle: Dodoma Wine Country | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Tanzanian wine. 5 hours small-group tour in Dodoma, Tanzania.

title: Maji Maji in Songea
summary: The Maji Maji Museum in Songea tells the story of the 1905 uprising against German colonial rule. A local guide explains the history and visits a memorial site.

seo.metaTitle: Maji Maji in Songea | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Resistance remembered. 4 hours small-group tour in Songea, Tanzania.

title: Kondoa: Paintings on the Rock
summary: The Kondoa rock-art sites are a UNESCO site with paintings thousands of years old. A guide leads you to several shelters and explains what the figures might mean.

seo.metaTitle: Kondoa: Paintings on the Rock | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Paintings above the plains. 2 days small-group tour in Kondoa, Tanzania.

title: Rubondo: Chimps on an Island
summary: Rubondo Island National Park sits in Lake Victoria and holds introduced chimpanzees, elephants and a rich birdlife. You stay overnight in a lodge and walk the forest with a ranger, then take a boat at dusk to look for sitatunga.

seo.metaTitle: Rubondo: Chimps on an Island | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Chimps on an island. 3 days small-group tour in Rubondo, Tanzania.

title: Bukoba on the Lake
summary: Bukoba is a quiet lake town in coffee country. You visit a coffee farm and a banana plantation and Haya cultural sites, with a lakeside lunch and a talk on how the Haya manage their land.

seo.metaTitle: Bukoba on the Lake | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Coffee country on the lake. 3 days small-group tour in Bukoba, Tanzania.

title: A Night with a Chagga Family
summary: Stay with a Chagga family on Kilimanjaro's slopes, helping with farm tasks and cooking dinner. You sleep in a simple room, eat food grown on the plot and wake to mountain views.

seo.metaTitle: A Night with a Chagga Family | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A night on the mountain. 2 days small-group tour in Moshi, Tanzania.

title: Lake Chala: The Swimming Crater
summary: Lake Chala sits in a crater on the Kenya border, clear and deep. A guide leads a walk around the rim and a swim in the green water.

seo.metaTitle: Lake Chala: The Swimming Crater | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A hidden crater lake. 5 hours small-group tour in Moshi, Tanzania.

title: Kilombero: Rice Valley Walk
summary: The Kilombero Valley is a huge floodplain where rice is grown. You walk the fields, meet farmers and look for puku antelope and waterbirds near the wetlands.

seo.metaTitle: Kilombero: Rice Valley Walk | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Wetlands and farmers. 2 days small-group tour in Ifakara, Tanzania.

title: Tingatinga Painters of Dar es Salaam
summary: The Tingatinga style began with Edward Saidi Tingatinga in the 1960s, using bicycle enamel paint on masonite squares. You visit a working cooperative near Msasani, watch the artists layer colour, and paint a small tile of your own under a painter's eye.

seo.metaTitle: Tingatinga Painters of Dar es Salaam | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Bright animals, enamel paint, one square tile at a time. 4 hours small-group tour in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

title: Mwenge Makonde Carvers
summary: Mwenge market is where Makonde carvers from southern Tanzania sell ebony sculptures, from stylised shetani spirits to family-tree totems that can take weeks to carve. A carver explains the symbolism and shows how the wood is chosen and finished.

seo.metaTitle: Mwenge Makonde Carvers | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Ebony, chisels and a decade per sculpture. 4 hours small-group tour in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

title: Meserani Snake Park and Maasai Museum
summary: A small park on the road to Longido with a collection of local snakes and a modest museum about Maasai life. A keeper handles species and explains venom, and a Maasai guide takes you through the museum's old photographs and tools.

seo.metaTitle: Meserani Snake Park and Maasai Museum | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Snakes first, history second. 3 hours small-group tour in Arusha, Tanzania.

title: Mkomazi: Rhinos Behind Fences and Wild Dogs Beyond
summary: Mkomazi National Park has a fenced rhino sanctuary and a wild dog breeding programme. A ranger walks you through the story of how the park recovered, and you drive the open country looking for gerenuk and lesser kudu.

seo.metaTitle: Mkomazi: Rhinos Behind Fences and Wild Dogs Beyond | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A reserve rebuilt from poaching. 2 days small-group tour in Mkomazi, Tanzania.

title: Rungwe Tea and Crater Lakes
summary: Around Tukuyu, tea estates sit between crater lakes and an extinct volcano. You visit a tea estate, hike to a lake and taste local bananas, which grow in many varieties here.

seo.metaTitle: Rungwe Tea and Crater Lakes | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Green hills in the south. 2 days small-group tour in Tukuyu, Tanzania.

title: Mikindani Old Town: Livingstone's House
summary: Mikindani is a restored Swahili town on the southern coast. David Livingstone stayed in the old boma, which is now a hotel. You walk the old slave market area, visit the German boma and sail to a nearby beach.

seo.metaTitle: Mikindani Old Town: Livingstone's House | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: A sleepy port with a big story. 2 days small-group tour in Mtwara, Tanzania.

title: Hanang: Climbing a Mountain Most Visitors Skip
summary: Mount Hanang rises to 3,417 metres and is considered sacred by the Barabaig. The climb is steep but short and ends with views across the Rift Valley. A guide and a porter come with you.

seo.metaTitle: Hanang: Climbing a Mountain Most Visitors Skip | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Cloud forest on the road to Babati. 2 days small-group tour in Katesh, Tanzania.

title: Rufiji Delta Mangroves
summary: The Rufiji Delta has dense mangrove forest, fishing villages and shallow channels. You travel by boat with a local guide, watch fishermen set nets and sleep in a village guesthouse.

seo.metaTitle: Rufiji Delta Mangroves | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Biggest mangrove forest in East Africa. 3 days small-group tour in Rufiji Delta, Tanzania.

title: Grumeti River Crossings
summary: The Grumeti River in the western Serengeti sees smaller crossings than the Mara, with large crocodiles waiting. We time the stay for the herd and use the western corridor roads.

seo.metaTitle: Grumeti River Crossings | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Crocs vs wildebeest, western corridor. 3 days small-group tour in Serengeti, Tanzania.

title: Machame: The Whiskey Route
summary: Machame is the most popular Kilimanjaro route for good reason: varied scenery, a good acclimatisation profile and the Barranco Wall scramble. A cook and a guide manage camps along the way.

seo.metaTitle: Machame: The Whiskey Route | Tanzania
seo.metaDescription: Seven days, wet boots, big views. 7 days small-group tour in Kilimanjaro, Tanzania.

title: Gorillas on Their Terms
groupSize: 2-8 guests (8 is the permit limit per gorilla family)
summary: You meet a habituated gorilla family on the slopes of the Virunga volcanoes. Trackers lead the way through bamboo and nettles, and you get one hour in the group's company. Long trousers and gloves are essential. Permits sell out, so book early.

seo.metaTitle: Gorillas on Their Terms | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: One hour with a family in the Virungas. 2 days small-group tour in Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda.

title: Golden Monkeys at the Bamboo Line
summary: Golden monkeys live in the bamboo belt of the Virungas and move constantly, so tracking them is half hike, half photography. You spend an hour with a troop, watching them strip bamboo shoots and tumble through the stalks.

seo.metaTitle: Golden Monkeys at the Bamboo Line | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Fast, orange and entirely unbothered. 5 hours small-group tour in Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda.

title: Dian Fossey's Grave Hike
summary: The hike to Karisoke Research Centre climbs through farmland and forest to the ruins of the camp where Dian Fossey worked. Her grave and those of gorillas she loved are nearby. The guide tells the story, including the unanswered questions around her death.

seo.metaTitle: Dian Fossey's Grave Hike | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A muddy walk to the camp where it began. 7 hours small-group tour in Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda.

title: Bisoke Crater Lake Climb
summary: Mount Bisoke is a steep half-day climb that ends on a crater rim above a small lake. The path is slick, the air thins out near the top, and when the cloud clears you can pick out the neighbouring volcanoes. A ranger leads and porters are available.

seo.metaTitle: Bisoke Crater Lake Climb | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A green lake at the top of a very muddy hill. 6 hours small-group tour in Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda.

title: Karisimbi in Two Days
summary: Karisimbi rises to 4,507 metres and is the highest of the Virunga volcanoes. You climb on day one to a sleeping spot at about 3,700 metres, then make the summit push at first light. Cold and wet are normal; bring proper layers.

seo.metaTitle: Karisimbi in Two Days | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Rwanda**'**s highest point, with a night at altitude. 2 days small-group tour in Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda.

title: Twin Lakes at Burera and Ruhondo
summary: Lake Burera and Lake Ruhondo sit side by side among terraced hills, with the Virunga volcanoes on the skyline. A local boatman paddles you across, and a village stop brings grilled tilapia and a walk through the farm plots.

seo.metaTitle: Twin Lakes at Burera and Ruhondo | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Two lakes, one narrow channel, a lot of terraces. 6 hours small-group tour in Musanze, Rwanda.

title: Musanze Caves: Lava Tubes Under the Farms
summary: The Musanze Caves are lava tubes formed by volcanic eruptions and run for roughly two kilometres under the farmland. You walk through chambers with a guide, learn what the caves meant to local communities, and spot bats on the ceiling.

seo.metaTitle: Musanze Caves: Lava Tubes Under the Farms | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Torch, helmet, lots of bats. 3 hours small-group tour in Musanze, Rwanda.

title: Gorilla Guardians Village
summary: This community-run village near the park is staffed by former poachers who now work in conservation. You hear their stories, watch Intore dancers, visit a reconstructed royal hut and meet a herbal healer who explains the plants around the village.

seo.metaTitle: Gorilla Guardians Village | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Former poachers, now hosts. 4 hours small-group tour in Musanze, Rwanda.

title: Learn the Intore Steps
summary: Intore is Rwanda's dance of the royal warriors, with leaping, arm sweeps and a heavy drum line. An instructor teaches you the basic footwork and shows how the rhythm works, then the troupe performs the full piece.

seo.metaTitle: Learn the Intore Steps | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Warrior dance, minus the spears. 3 hours small-group tour in Musanze, Rwanda.

title: Cycling Country: A Ride from Musanze
summary: Musanze is a base for Rwanda's cycling culture, with a cycling centre that trains riders. You ride a gentle road loop with a local guide, stop in a village for tea and learn about the Tour of Rwanda. Bikes are provided.

seo.metaTitle: Cycling Country: A Ride from Musanze | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Roads that Rwandan racers train on. 4 hours small-group tour in Musanze, Rwanda.

title: Sabyinyo: Three Jagged Peaks
summary: Mount Sabyinyo's name means old man's teeth, and its three peaks are the borders of Rwanda, Uganda and DR Congo. The hike is steep, includes a ladder section and gives the full volcano view from the ridge.

seo.metaTitle: Sabyinyo: Three Jagged Peaks | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: The border summit hike. 8 hours small-group tour in Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda.

title: Gahinga and Muhabura: Two Cones, One Long Day
summary: Gahinga is the shorter climb, ending at a swampy crater, while Muhabura is a longer ascent and a clean cone. A guide splits the day so you can do both or choose one.

seo.metaTitle: Gahinga and Muhabura: Two Cones, One Long Day | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Border volcanoes. 8 hours small-group tour in Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda.

title: Potato Fields Below the Volcanoes
summary: Kinigi is a farming area at the base of the volcanoes, famed for potatoes and pyrethrum. You work alongside a farming family, harvest potatoes with a hoe and eat lunch in their home, with the volcano slopes in the background.

seo.metaTitle: Potato Fields Below the Volcanoes | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A morning with a farming family. 4 hours small-group tour in Kinigi, Rwanda.

title: Kwita Izina: Naming the Baby Gorillas
summary: Each year, usually in September, Rwanda holds a ceremony in which newborn gorillas are given names. The event mixes conservation talks, dance and community celebration. Dates change annually.

seo.metaTitle: Kwita Izina: Naming the Baby Gorillas | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: An annual celebration in Kinigi. 2 days small-group tour in Kinigi, Rwanda.

title: Nyungwe Canopy Walk
summary: The Uwinka canopy walkway is a suspended bridge about 50 metres above the forest floor. Go early for the best chance of birds and monkeys. A guide meets you at the trailhead and walks the connecting forest paths afterwards.

seo.metaTitle: Nyungwe Canopy Walk | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: 160 metres of swaying bridge. 5 hours small-group tour in Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda.

title: The Source of the Nile Trek
summary: Rwanda's Rukarara and Mwogo streams in Nyungwe are one of the claimed sources of the Nile. You hike with a ranger through montane forest to the source point, camp near the trail and learn why geographers still argue about it.

seo.metaTitle: The Source of the Nile Trek | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Walk to where the river might begin. 2 days small-group tour in Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda.

title: Igishigishigi: The Quiet Trail to the Canopy
summary: Most visitors drive to the canopy walkway. This route walks there along the Igishigishigi trail, through tree ferns and giant lobelias, with a ranger naming birds and primates. You cross the walkway last, mostly alone.

seo.metaTitle: Igishigishigi: The Quiet Trail to the Canopy | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: The same bridge, a longer approach. 4 hours small-group tour in Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda.

title: Karamba Birding at First Light
summary: The Karamba trail runs through forest edge and marsh and is one of the best places to see Albertine Rift endemics. A ranger-birder leads at dawn, calling out Rwenzori turaco and handsome francolin by sound before you spot them.

seo.metaTitle: Karamba Birding at First Light | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Dozens of Albertine Rift species before breakfast. 5 hours small-group tour in Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda.

title: Chimps of Nyungwe at Dawn
summary: Trackers leave before sunrise to find the habituated chimp group. The terrain is steep and wet, and you get an hour with the chimps once found. Sleep near the park gate the night before.

seo.metaTitle: Chimps of Nyungwe at Dawn | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A morning with an ape community. 2 days small-group tour in Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda.

title: Isumo Waterfall Day Hike
summary: The Isumo trail starts among tea plantations, drops through forest and ends at a double waterfall. It's a long day with river crossings, and a ranger leads the way and carries lunch.

seo.metaTitle: Isumo Waterfall Day Hike | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Tea fields, forest, and a long drop. 8 hours small-group tour in Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda.

title: Kitabi Eco-Centre: Community on the Forest Edge
summary: Kitabi sits at the northern edge of Nyungwe and has cooperatives that work with the park. You meet beekeepers, basket weavers and former poachers turned guides, then walk a short forest trail with one of them.

seo.metaTitle: Kitabi Eco-Centre: Community on the Forest Edge | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Honey, baskets and forest guides. 5 hours small-group tour in Nyamagabe, Rwanda.

title: Colobus by the Hundred
summary: Nyungwe holds one of Africa's largest troops of Angola colobus, sometimes numbering several hundred. A tracker leads you to the group, and you watch them leap through the canopy from beneath.

seo.metaTitle: Colobus by the Hundred | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A troop of 400 in the treetops. 5 hours small-group tour in Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda.

title: Bigugu Summit Hike
summary: Mount Bigugu is the highest point in Nyungwe at about 2,950 metres. The trail is steep and wet, and the summit gives views across a sea of green.

seo.metaTitle: Bigugu Summit Hike | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Highest point in the forest. 8 hours small-group tour in Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda.

title: Nyungwe Tea Pickers' Morning
summary: Gisakura tea estate borders Nyungwe. Pickers show how to pluck two leaves and a bud, you try picking for a short stretch and a factory guide follows the leaf to the finished tea, ending with a tasting.

seo.metaTitle: Nyungwe Tea Pickers' Morning | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Join the harvest. 4 hours small-group tour in Nyamasheke, Rwanda.

title: Akagera Game Drive at Dawn
summary: Akagera has lions and black rhinos reintroduced in recent years. Early game drives cover savannah, wetlands and hills with a ranger-guide, and you sleep inside the park.

seo.metaTitle: Akagera Game Drive at Dawn | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Lions, rhinos and giraffe on open plains. 2 days small-group tour in Akagera National Park, Rwanda.

title: Akagera After Dark
summary: A night drive in Akagera reveals hyenas, genets, white-tailed mongooses and nightjars. A ranger uses a spotlight and explains behaviour, and sometimes a leopard turns up.

seo.metaTitle: Akagera After Dark | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Eyes in the torchlight. 3 hours small-group tour in Akagera National Park, Rwanda.

title: Lake Ihema by Boat
summary: Lake Ihema is Akagera's largest lake. A boat trip at golden hour puts you at water level with hippo pods, crocodiles and fish eagles, and the guide points out shoebill habitats.

seo.metaTitle: Lake Ihema by Boat | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Hippos, crocs and fish eagles. 3 hours small-group tour in Akagera National Park, Rwanda.

title: Akagera's Black Rhino Story
summary: Black rhinos were reintroduced to Akagera in 2017 after being wiped out. A ranger takes you tracking, explains monitoring and guarding, and shows the places where rhinos feed.

seo.metaTitle: Akagera's Black Rhino Story | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Back from the brink. 6 hours small-group tour in Akagera National Park, Rwanda.

title: Shoebill Chasing on Lake Shakani
summary: The papyrus beds around Lake Shakani are one of the few places in Rwanda where a shoebill might appear. A bird guide leads a slow boat trip. No sightings are guaranteed, but the papyrus gonolek is a good fallback.

seo.metaTitle: Shoebill Chasing on Lake Shakani | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Papyrus and patience. 5 hours small-group tour in Akagera National Park, Rwanda.

title: Mutumba Hills Sundowner
summary: The Mutumba Hills rise above Akagera's southern plains. We drive up in late afternoon, set up a sundowner and watch giraffe and zebra move across the plains below.

seo.metaTitle: Mutumba Hills Sundowner | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: High ground for the evening. 3 hours small-group tour in Akagera National Park, Rwanda.

title: Rusumo Falls on the Tanzanian Border
summary: Rusumo Falls on the Kagera River marks the border between Rwanda and Tanzania, where the water narrows into rapids. A guide walks you to a viewpoint on the Rwandan side, explains the river's role as the farthest source of the Nile and takes you into a riverside village for lunch.

seo.metaTitle: Rusumo Falls on the Tanzanian Border | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A river on its way north. 6 hours small-group tour in Kirehe, Rwanda.

title: Lake Mugesera Sunrise Fishing
summary: Lake Mugesera is quieter and shallower than Lake Kivu, with an island at its centre. Fishermen paddle out at first light and you can join one, then eat a fried tilapia breakfast on the jetty.

seo.metaTitle: Lake Mugesera Sunrise Fishing | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Quiet water, local boats. 5 hours small-group tour in Rwamagana, Rwanda.

title: Muhazi: The Lake Close to Kigali
summary: Lake Muhazi is an hour from Kigali, long and narrow with hills on both sides. You take a boat across, have lunch at a lakeside restaurant and swim from a jetty.

seo.metaTitle: Muhazi: The Lake Close to Kigali | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Lakeside slow day. 7 hours small-group tour in Gicumbi, Rwanda.

title: Ankole Cattle Country
summary: Nyagatare in the north-east has ranches raising long-horned Ankole cattle. You visit a ranch with a herder and learn how they are bred and milked.

seo.metaTitle: Ankole Cattle Country | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Long horns, long grass. 5 hours small-group tour in Nyagatare, Rwanda.

title: The Royal Cows of Nyanza
summary: The Inyambo are long-horned cows traditionally kept by the Rwandan kings. At Nyanza a herder sings to the herd and explains the tradition of cattle poetry.

seo.metaTitle: The Royal Cows of Nyanza | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A herder sings to them. 4 hours small-group tour in Nyanza, Rwanda.

title: Inside the King's Palace at Nyanza
summary: The King's Palace in Nyanza has a replica of a traditional royal residence with a thatched hut and fence. A guide explains the layout, the symbolism and the role of the king.

seo.metaTitle: Inside the King's Palace at Nyanza | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A reconstructed royal home. 4 hours small-group tour in Nyanza, Rwanda.

title: Rwesero Art Museum
summary: The Rwesero Art Museum, a short drive from the King's Palace, shows contemporary Rwandan art in a former royal residence. A curator walks you through the collection.

seo.metaTitle: Rwesero Art Museum | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Contemporary art in the old palace. 3 hours small-group tour in Nyanza, Rwanda.

title: Huye's National Museum
summary: The Ethnographic Museum in Huye holds thousands of objects showing Rwandan life. A museum guide takes you through the highlights, from farming tools to royal drums.

seo.metaTitle: Huye's National Museum | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Rwanda**'**s biggest collection. 3 hours small-group tour in Huye, Rwanda.

title: Ruhande Arboretum Walk
summary: The Arboretum de Ruhande is a research forest on the edge of Huye, planted with trees from several continents. A botanist walks you among the labelled specimens, points out the colobus and blue monkeys and explains how the arboretum supports the university.

seo.metaTitle: Ruhande Arboretum Walk | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Trees from everywhere. 3 hours small-group tour in Huye, Rwanda.

title: Kibeho: A Hilltop of Pilgrims
summary: Kibeho is a Catholic pilgrimage site in southern Rwanda, known for reported Marian apparitions in the 1980s. A local guide explains the place and its history with respect.

seo.metaTitle: Kibeho: A Hilltop of Pilgrims | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Quiet and reverent. 5 hours small-group tour in Nyaruguru, Rwanda.

title: Kivu at First Light by Kayak
summary: Lake Kivu is flat and silent in the early morning. You paddle a kayak along the shore past fishing villages and small islands, with a guide who knows where the kingfishers nest, and return to a breakfast of eggs and fresh bread.

seo.metaTitle: Kivu at First Light by Kayak | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Paddle before breakfast. 3 hours small-group tour in Karongi, Rwanda.

title: Napoleon Island Fruit Bats
summary: A boat takes you to Napoleon Island, where thousands of straw-coloured fruit bats hang from the trees by day. Your guide explains their migration and role in seed dispersal, and you can swim off a small beach on the way back.

seo.metaTitle: Napoleon Island Fruit Bats | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Thousands hanging in trees. 4 hours small-group tour in Karongi, Rwanda.

title: Amahoro Island Picnic
summary: Amahoro Island is a tiny island on Lake Kivu with a picnic spot. A boat drops you off with lunch and picks you up in the afternoon.

seo.metaTitle: Amahoro Island Picnic | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A little island for lunch. 5 hours small-group tour in Karongi, Rwanda.

title: Congo Nile Trail by Bike
summary: A guided ride on a section of the Congo Nile Trail follows a ridge road above Lake Kivu through tea fields and villages. A support vehicle carries gear, the climbs are short but steep and a lakeside lodge waits at the end.

seo.metaTitle: Congo Nile Trail by Bike | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A ridge road above Lake Kivu. 2 days small-group tour in Karongi, Rwanda.

title: Gisenyi Lake Days
summary: Gisenyi sits on Lake Kivu with a view of Nyiragongo across the border. You swim from a sandy beach, rent a paddleboard, and eat fried fish and chips at a lakeside restaurant while the volcano glows at dusk.

seo.metaTitle: Gisenyi Lake Days | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Sand and a volcano view. 6 hours small-group tour in Rubavu, Rwanda.

title: Nyamyumba Hot Springs
summary: Nyamyumba's hot springs bubble out of the hillside a short drive from Gisenyi. You soak in warm water pools with views of Lake Kivu and learn from a local guide how the community looks after the springs.

seo.metaTitle: Nyamyumba Hot Springs | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Soak and stare. 3 hours small-group tour in Rubavu, Rwanda.

title: Chukudu: The Wooden Scooter
summary: The chukudu is a wooden scooter used to haul goods down the hills. A local rider shows you how it works and lets you try.

seo.metaTitle: Chukudu: The Wooden Scooter | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Hill-road transport. 3 hours small-group tour in Rubavu, Rwanda.

title: Kivu Belt Ride
summary: The Kivu Belt is a rolling road along the lake from Rubavu to Rusizi. A day ride covers a section with a guide, stopping for lake views, fishing villages and a roadside cassava snack.

seo.metaTitle: Kivu Belt Ride | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Cycle the lake road. 8 hours small-group tour in Rusizi, Rwanda.

title: Gishwati-Mukura: Rwanda's Newest National Park
summary: Gishwati-Mukura became a national park in 2015 after decades of forest clearing and conservation work. A ranger leads you through restored forest to find chimpanzees and golden monkeys, and explains the replanting project.

seo.metaTitle: Gishwati-Mukura: Rwanda's Newest National Park | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Chimps in a regrown forest. 2 days small-group tour in Rutsiro, Rwanda.

title: Kigali Car-Free Day
summary: On car-free days certain roads close and Kigali residents walk, jog and cycle. You join a morning with an aerobics class and a street breakfast.

seo.metaTitle: Kigali Car-Free Day | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Join the city on foot. 3 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Nyamirambo Walking Tour
summary: Nyamirambo is a lively Kigali district with mosques, barber shops and women-run community projects. A resident leads the tour and you eat at a family-run place.

seo.metaTitle: Nyamirambo Walking Tour | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: The lively side of town. 4 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Mount Kigali Hike
summary: Mount Kigali rises above the city and is covered in eucalyptus and indigenous forest. A guide leads the ridge hike, explains Kigali's seven hills and points out landmarks, with a view across the valley to the Convention Centre.

seo.metaTitle: Mount Kigali Hike | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Kigali from the ridge. 4 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Nyandungu Eco-Park
summary: The Nyandungu Urban Wetland Eco-Tourism Park turned a degraded wetland into a boardwalked nature reserve in the east of Kigali. A guide walks you around the ponds, naming herons, ibis and waterfowl, and tells the restoration story.

seo.metaTitle: Nyandungu Eco-Park | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A restored wetland in the city. 3 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Kandt House Museum
summary: Richard Kandt, a German doctor and the first colonial resident of Kigali, lived in this small house. It is now a natural history museum with a reptile house, and a curator shows you the exhibits and the garden.

seo.metaTitle: Kandt House Museum | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Natural history in the city. 3 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Kigali Convention Centre at Night
summary: The Kigali Convention Centre is a domed building that lights up at night in the colours of the Rwandan flag. A photographer leads a walk to the best vantage points around Kimihurura, and you stop for a late dinner nearby.

seo.metaTitle: Kigali Convention Centre at Night | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: The glowing dome. 2 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Rwanda Art Museum
summary: The Rwanda Art Museum occupies the former presidential palace, with a gallery of contemporary Rwandan art. A guide walks you through the rooms, explains the building's role and gives the background of the artists.

seo.metaTitle: Rwanda Art Museum | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: The old presidential palace. 3 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Moto Taxi City Loop
summary: Motorbike taxis are how many Kigali residents get around. With a licensed rider and helmets, you ride between hills and neighbourhoods and stop at three places a local would take you, from a roadside brochette stand to a hill viewpoint.

seo.metaTitle: Moto Taxi City Loop | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Kigali on a helmeted back seat. 3 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Musanze Market Morning
summary: Musanze market is packed with potatoes, beans, fruit and bundles of sorghum from the northern highlands. A guide shows what is in season, explains how prices are set and helps you buy a few things for a picnic.

seo.metaTitle: Musanze Market Morning | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Potatoes, fruit and chatter. 3 hours small-group tour in Musanze, Rwanda.

title: Kivu Sunset by Boat
summary: A boatman paddles or motors you out on Lake Kivu in the late afternoon. The hills turn purple, fishermen set their lamps and you drink Rwandan tea or a local beer while the sky changes colour.

seo.metaTitle: Kivu Sunset by Boat | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Light off the water, no engine noise. 3 hours small-group tour in Karongi, Rwanda.

title: Isambaza at Night: Lamp Fishing on Kivu
summary: Fishermen on Kivu use lamps to lure isambaza, a small sardine-like fish, into their nets after dark. You go out with a crew, watch the net come up silver and eat a fresh fry on the shore.

seo.metaTitle: Isambaza at Night: Lamp Fishing on Kivu | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Tiny fish, big catch. 4 hours small-group tour in Rubavu, Rwanda.

title: Kibuye Peninsula Walk
summary: The Bwishyura peninsula pokes into Lake Kivu with trails between coves and eucalyptus groves. A local guide leads a loop walk, points out birds and stops for lunch at a lakeside restaurant.

seo.metaTitle: Kibuye Peninsula Walk | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Hills, coves and a long view. 4 hours small-group tour in Karongi, Rwanda.

title: Rugezi Marsh: Waterbirds at Dawn
summary: Rugezi is a protected marsh between Burera and Ruhondo lakes and home to the grey crowned crane and the Grauer's swamp warbler. A bird guide leads a slow walk on the edge of the wetland.

seo.metaTitle: Rugezi Marsh: Waterbirds at Dawn | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Ramsar wetland in the north. 5 hours small-group tour in Burera, Rwanda.

title: Mulindi Tea and the Gicumbi Hills
summary: Gicumbi's hills carry some of Rwanda's older tea plantations. A picker shows how leaves are plucked, a factory guide walks you through the withering sheds and you taste the tea in a plantation cottage.

seo.metaTitle: Mulindi Tea and the Gicumbi Hills | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Pickers on a quiet slope. 5 hours small-group tour in Gicumbi, Rwanda.

title: Ruhondo Island Day
summary: Lake Ruhondo has small islands, hills on every side and fishing villages along the shore. You paddle across, walk the island paths and eat a lakeside lunch of tilapia and cassava.

seo.metaTitle: Ruhondo Island Day | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Lake, boats, and a lot of green. 6 hours small-group tour in Musanze, Rwanda.

title: Hippos on the Rusizi
summary: The Rusizi River runs from Kivu to Burundi and holds hippos and water birds in its reed beds. A local guide takes you by boat at dusk and explains the river's border role.

seo.metaTitle: Hippos on the Rusizi | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Where the river meets Kivu. 4 hours small-group tour in Rusizi, Rwanda.

title: Akagera Camp-Out
summary: You sleep inside Akagera at a campsite beside the lake. Game drives frame the day and the night belongs to hyenas, nightjars and the sound of hippos grazing outside the tent.

seo.metaTitle: Akagera Camp-Out | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Tent, fire, hyena whoop. 2 days small-group tour in Akagera National Park, Rwanda.

title: Akagera Birding: Papyrus Endemics
summary: Akagera's wetlands hold the papyrus gonolek, red-faced barbet and an occasional shoebill. A bird guide leads dawn drives and a boat trip into the papyrus.

seo.metaTitle: Akagera Birding: Papyrus Endemics | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Gonolek, shoebill, and swamp specialists. 2 days small-group tour in Akagera National Park, Rwanda.

title: Volcano Dawn Photography
summary: A photographer guide takes you to hill viewpoints near Musanze before sunrise to catch the Virunga peaks in dawn light. Includes a breakfast stop with farmers.

seo.metaTitle: Volcano Dawn Photography | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Five peaks in pink light. 4 hours small-group tour in Musanze, Rwanda.

title: Muhazi Kayak and Fish Lunch
summary: Lake Muhazi is long and narrow, ideal for a kayak morning. You paddle with a guide, spot kingfishers and finish with grilled tilapia at a lakeside restaurant.

seo.metaTitle: Muhazi Kayak and Fish Lunch | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Paddle then eat. 5 hours small-group tour in Gicumbi, Rwanda.

title: Nyabarongo Wetland Birding
summary: The Nyabarongo River floods its valley and forms wetlands near Kigali. A bird guide walks the edge at dawn, naming herons, crowned cranes and ibis, and explains why the wetland matters for flood control.

seo.metaTitle: Nyabarongo Wetland Birding | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Cranes and herons near the capital. 4 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Congo Nile Trail on Foot
summary: A section of the Congo Nile Trail runs along ridges above Lake Kivu. You walk with a guide past villages and tea fields and finish at a lakeside lodge.

seo.metaTitle: Congo Nile Trail on Foot | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: A day**'**s walk above the lake. 8 hours small-group tour in Rubavu, Rwanda.

title: Cyangugu Border Town Stroll
summary: Cyangugu, now Rusizi, sits on the lakeshore beside the Congo and Burundi borders. You walk the lakeside promenade, visit the market and eat grilled fish at a local canteen, with a guide explaining the town's role as a trade junction.

seo.metaTitle: Cyangugu Border Town Stroll | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Where Rwanda meets Congo and Burundi. 3 hours small-group tour in Rusizi, Rwanda.

title: Kigali Hills by Bicycle
summary: Kigali is built on hills, and cycling it is a workout. A guide leads a loop through neighbourhoods and viewpoints, with stops for fruit and coffee.

seo.metaTitle: Kigali Hills by Bicycle | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Seven hills, lots of gears. 4 hours small-group tour in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Nyungwe Honey Collectors
summary: Beekeepers near Nyungwe harvest honey from hives set in the trees. You help with a harvest, taste honey from the comb and learn how the cooperatives protect the forest.

seo.metaTitle: Nyungwe Honey Collectors | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Hives on the forest edge. 4 hours small-group tour in Nyamagabe, Rwanda.

title: Burera Canoe Camp
summary: Lake Burera has small islands, quiet fishing villages and volcano views. You paddle a canoe with a local fisherman, camp on the shore and wake to mist rising off the water before a breakfast of boiled eggs and sweet potato.

seo.metaTitle: Burera Canoe Camp | Rwanda
seo.metaDescription: Sleep beside the lake. 2 days small-group tour in Burera, Rwanda.

title: Felucca Dawn at Elephantine
summary: A felucca captain takes you around Elephantine Island on a breeze with no engine. You pass granite boulders, the Aga Khan Mausoleum and Nubian villages while he brews karkadeh tea on a little stove.

seo.metaTitle: Felucca Dawn at Elephantine | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Sail the Nile before the sun is high. 3 hours small-group tour in Aswan, Egypt.

title: Nubian Village, a Proper Welcome
summary: A boat crosses the Nile to a Nubian village where houses are painted in bright blues and yellows. A host family serves tea, shows how henna is applied and cooks lunch, and you can meet a pet crocodile kept in a courtyard pool.

seo.metaTitle: Nubian Village, a Proper Welcome | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Painted houses, home cooking and a baby crocodile. 6 hours small-group tour in Aswan, Egypt.

title: Philae at Golden Hour
summary: The Temple of Isis at Philae was dismantled and rebuilt on higher ground when the Aswan dam flooded its island. A boat carries you across the lake, and a guide explains the cult of Isis and the rescue project.

seo.metaTitle: Philae at Golden Hour | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Temple moved stone by stone. 3 hours small-group tour in Aswan, Egypt.

title: Abu Simbel Before the Buses
summary: We leave Aswan in the small hours so you arrive when the sun hits the Great Temple's facade and the crowds are still en route. A guide explains how Ramesses II built the temples and how engineers moved them in the 1960s.

seo.metaTitle: Abu Simbel Before the Buses | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Two rock temples, one very early start. 12 hours small-group tour in Abu Simbel, Egypt.

title: Unfinished Obelisk and Granite Quarry
summary: Aswan's granite quarries supplied stone for temples across Egypt. The Unfinished Obelisk, abandoned when it cracked, shows how ancient masons cut and shaped stone. A guide explains the techniques and how it would have been moved.

seo.metaTitle: Unfinished Obelisk and Granite Quarry | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: The one that cracked. 3 hours small-group tour in Aswan, Egypt.

title: Aswan Souq After Dark
summary: Aswan's main street souq sells hibiscus, dried limes, Nubian baskets and spices. A local guide steers you to honest vendors and helps you bargain, and you finish with fresh sugarcane juice.

seo.metaTitle: Aswan Souq After Dark | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Spices, hibiscus and a very good argument. 3 hours small-group tour in Aswan, Egypt.

title: Edfu at Sunrise by Horse Carriage
summary: The Temple of Horus at Edfu is one of Egypt's best-preserved. A calash driver takes you through the town in the cool morning, and a guide explains the reliefs that tell the story of Horus and Seth.

seo.metaTitle: Edfu at Sunrise by Horse Carriage | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Best-preserved temple, slow arrival. 4 hours small-group tour in Edfu, Egypt.

title: Kom Ombo: Two Gods, One Temple
summary: Kom Ombo's temple is split down the middle, one half for Sobek the crocodile god and the other for Horus. A small museum next door has mummified crocodiles, and the setting on the Nile at sunset is lovely.

seo.metaTitle: Kom Ombo: Two Gods, One Temple | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Crocodile mummies and a double sanctuary. 3 hours small-group tour in Kom Ombo, Egypt.

title: Luxor West Bank by Bicycle
summary: Cycling the West Bank takes you through sugarcane fields and villages to the Valley of the Kings. A guide handles tickets and explains the tombs, and you stop for tea with a farming family on the way back.

seo.metaTitle: Luxor West Bank by Bicycle | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Pedal through fields to the Valley. 8 hours small-group tour in Luxor, Egypt.

title: Hatshepsut's Terraces at First Light
summary: The mortuary temple of Hatshepsut sits against pale cliffs on Luxor's West Bank. Early morning light turns the terraces gold, and a guide tells the story of the woman who ruled as pharaoh.

seo.metaTitle: Hatshepsut's Terraces at First Light | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: A queen**'**s temple cut into a cliff. 3 hours small-group tour in Luxor, Egypt.

title: Tombs of the Nobles
summary: The Tombs of the Nobles hold some of Egypt's finest painted walls, with scenes of harvest, fishing, feasts and music. A guide opens a handful of tombs and explains the daily life they show.

seo.metaTitle: Tombs of the Nobles | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Painted scenes of ordinary life. 4 hours small-group tour in Luxor, Egypt.

title: Deir el-Medina: The Workers' Village
summary: Deir el-Medina was home to the craftsmen who built the royal tombs. A guide explains their strike records, family lives and their own small decorated tombs.

seo.metaTitle: Deir el-Medina: The Workers' Village | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Where the tomb builders lived. 3 hours small-group tour in Luxor, Egypt.

title: Karnak After Dinner
summary: Karnak is huge, and in the evening it feels quieter and cooler. A guide walks the Hypostyle Hall, the sacred lake and the obelisks, and the sound-and-light show adds drama.

seo.metaTitle: Karnak After Dinner | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Sound, stone and a very long colonnade. 3 hours small-group tour in Luxor, Egypt.

title: Luxor Temple by Lamplight
summary: Luxor Temple sits beside a busy road and a mosque, which makes it feel alive. After dark, the lighting makes the colonnades glow, and the avenue of sphinxes leads you to Karnak.

seo.metaTitle: Luxor Temple by Lamplight | Egypt
