seo.metaDescription: The temple in the middle of town. 2 hours small-group tour in Luxor, Egypt.

title: Balloon over the Theban Hills
summary: A hot air balloon rises at dawn over farmland and the temples of the West Bank. The flight lasts about 45 minutes and ends with a bumpy landing in a field.

seo.metaTitle: Balloon over the Theban Hills | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Dawn flight over the West Bank. 4 hours small-group tour in Luxor, Egypt.

title: Dendera: Hathor's Ceiling
summary: Dendera's Temple of Hathor has an astronomical ceiling and a roof you can climb. The famous zodiac relief was removed to Paris, but the replica and the rest of the temple are worth the trip.

seo.metaTitle: Dendera: Hathor's Ceiling | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: The zodiac that ended up in Paris. 6 hours small-group tour in Dendera, Egypt.

title: Abydos: Osiris and the Kings List
summary: The Temple of Seti I at Abydos has a famous list of pharaohs carved on its walls and some of the finest reliefs in Egypt. A guide explains the Osiris cult and the nearby Osireion.

seo.metaTitle: Abydos: Osiris and the Kings List | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: The temple of the kings list. 8 hours small-group tour in Abydos, Egypt.

title: Dahab Blue Hole Freedive Intro
summary: Dahab is known for freediving, and an instructor takes beginners through breathing techniques at the Blue Hole. The first session is in shallow water, with safety divers close by.

seo.metaTitle: Dahab Blue Hole Freedive Intro | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Calm water, deep breath. 6 hours small-group tour in Dahab, Egypt.

title: Coloured Canyon Hike
summary: The Coloured Canyon in Sinai is a narrow gorge with banded sandstone walls. A Bedouin guide drives you into the desert, leads you through the canyon and explains the rock layers.

seo.metaTitle: Coloured Canyon Hike | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Sandstone walls in orange and purple. 6 hours small-group tour in Nuweiba, Egypt.

title: St Catherine's Monastery and Mount Sinai
summary: Pilgrims climb Mount Sinai at night to see sunrise from the summit. A Bedouin guide leads you up by torchlight, then you visit St Catherine's Monastery, one of the oldest working monasteries in the world.

seo.metaTitle: St Catherine's Monastery and Mount Sinai | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Climb for sunrise. 12 hours small-group tour in Sinai, Egypt.

title: Ras Mohammed Reef Snorkel
summary: Ras Mohammed is Egypt's first national park, with coral walls and schools of fish. A boat takes you to two snorkel sites, and a guide explains the reef ecology.

seo.metaTitle: Ras Mohammed Reef Snorkel | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: The famous marine park. 8 hours small-group tour in Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt.

title: Hurghada Giftun Island Boat Day
summary: A boat from Hurghada takes you to Giftun Island, with sandy beaches and clear water. You snorkel at two reefs, eat a grilled fish lunch and relax on the sand.

seo.metaTitle: Hurghada Giftun Island Boat Day | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Sandbar and reef. 8 hours small-group tour in Hurghada, Egypt.

title: Marsa Alam Dugong Search
summary: Marsa Alam's Abu Dabbab Bay is known for dugongs and sea turtles grazing on seagrass. A guide takes you out in small groups, and you snorkel quietly to avoid disturbing the animals.

seo.metaTitle: Marsa Alam Dugong Search | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Seagrass and sea turtles. 6 hours small-group tour in Marsa Alam, Egypt.

title: Wadi el-Gemal Desert and Sea
summary: Wadi el-Gemal National Park combines desert wadis, mangroves and coral reef. A Bedouin guide drives you through the wadi, shows ancient emerald mines and you sleep in a tent near the coast.

seo.metaTitle: Wadi el-Gemal Desert and Sea | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Where mountains meet the Red Sea. 2 days small-group tour in Wadi el-Gemal, Egypt.

title: Siwa Oasis: Salt Lakes and Date Groves
summary: Siwa is an oasis near the Libyan border with its own Berber language, date palms and salt lakes. You float in a salt lake, visit the Temple of the Oracle and the old fortress of Shali, and ride a jeep over the dunes.

seo.metaTitle: Siwa Oasis: Salt Lakes and Date Groves | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Egypt**'**s far west. 3 days small-group tour in Siwa, Egypt.

title: Cleopatra's Spring and Siwa Sunset
summary: A natural pool called Cleopatra's Spring bubbles at Siwa. You swim in the clear water, then climb to Gebel al-Mawta, the Mountain of the Dead, for sunset over the oasis.

seo.metaTitle: Cleopatra's Spring and Siwa Sunset | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Hot spring on a hill. 4 hours small-group tour in Siwa, Egypt.

title: Great Sand Sea Jeep Run
summary: A jeep driver takes you over the dunes of the Great Sand Sea, stopping for sandboarding and a picnic. The route passes a spring in the middle of nowhere.

seo.metaTitle: Great Sand Sea Jeep Run | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Dunes as far as you can see. 8 hours small-group tour in Siwa, Egypt.

title: Bahariya and the Black and White Deserts
summary: From Bahariya Oasis you drive into the Black Desert, with its volcanic hills, then the White Desert, where chalk rock formations look like mushrooms. You camp overnight under the stars.

seo.metaTitle: Bahariya and the Black and White Deserts | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Chalk rocks and black mountains. 3 days small-group tour in Bahariya, Egypt.

title: Farafra Oasis and the Crystal Mountain
summary: Farafra is a quiet oasis with a museum made of mud by the artist Badr. You visit the museum, the hot springs and the Crystal Mountain, a quartz-crystal ridge near the road.

seo.metaTitle: Farafra Oasis and the Crystal Mountain | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Art in the sand. 2 days small-group tour in Farafra, Egypt.

title: Kharga and Dakhla: The Lost Oases
summary: Dakhla Oasis has a medieval town called al-Qasr with narrow mud-brick lanes. You walk the old town, visit the Roman tomb at Muzawwaqa and soak in a hot spring.

seo.metaTitle: Kharga and Dakhla: The Lost Oases | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Tombs, citadels and mud-brick villages. 3 days small-group tour in Dakhla, Egypt.

title: Fayoum: Wadi Rayan Falls and Qarun
summary: The Fayoum Oasis lies south-west of Cairo and holds Egypt's only natural waterfalls at Wadi Rayan. You take a boat on the lake and visit the whale valley at Wadi el-Hitan.

seo.metaTitle: Fayoum: Wadi Rayan Falls and Qarun | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Waterfalls in the desert. 8 hours small-group tour in Fayoum, Egypt.

title: Wadi el-Hitan: The Valley of the Whales
summary: Wadi el-Hitan is a UNESCO site where fossilised whale skeletons lie in the sand. A guide explains how these whales had legs and walks you along a trail among the bones.

seo.metaTitle: Wadi el-Hitan: The Valley of the Whales | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Fossils on the desert floor. 8 hours small-group tour in Fayoum, Egypt.

title: Tunis Village Pottery
summary: Tunis Village on Lake Qarun has become a centre for pottery and weaving. You throw a pot with a local potter and walk the lakeside.

seo.metaTitle: Tunis Village Pottery | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Potters by a lake. 4 hours small-group tour in Fayoum, Egypt.

title: Alexandria's Catacombs and Pompey's Pillar
summary: The Catacombs of Kom el-Shoqafa are a Roman-era burial site that blends Egyptian and Greek styles. Nearby Pompey's Pillar was part of an ancient temple. A guide explains both.

seo.metaTitle: Alexandria's Catacombs and Pompey's Pillar | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Roman underground. 4 hours small-group tour in Alexandria, Egypt.

title: Qaitbay Citadel on the Waterfront
summary: The Citadel of Qaitbay was built on the site of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria. A guide tells the story of the lighthouse and the fort, and the sea views are superb.

seo.metaTitle: Qaitbay Citadel on the Waterfront | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: A fort on the Pharos site. 3 hours small-group tour in Alexandria, Egypt.

title: Bibliotheca Alexandrina
summary: The new Library of Alexandria is a striking disc-shaped building. A guide explains the project and the story of the ancient library, and you can see the manuscript museum.

seo.metaTitle: Bibliotheca Alexandrina | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: A library that rose again. 3 hours small-group tour in Alexandria, Egypt.

title: Alexandria Fish Market Lunch
summary: Alexandria's seafood restaurants let you choose your fish from ice and have it grilled. A local guide helps you pick and bargain, and you eat by the water.

seo.metaTitle: Alexandria Fish Market Lunch | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Choose your fish, they grill it. 3 hours small-group tour in Alexandria, Egypt.

title: Rosetta (Rashid) Old Houses
summary: Rosetta, or Rashid, is where the stone that helped decode hieroglyphs was found in 1799. The town has well-preserved Ottoman merchant houses with carved wooden screens, a fort and a quiet Nile branch. A guide walks the old streets and you eat river fish for lunch.

seo.metaTitle: Rosetta (Rashid) Old Houses | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Ottoman houses by the river. 6 hours small-group tour in Rosetta, Egypt.

title: Port Said Waterfront
summary: Port Said sits at the northern end of the Suez Canal. You walk the colonial-era architecture, watch ships queue and ride a ferry across to Port Fuad.

seo.metaTitle: Port Said Waterfront | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: The canal city. 6 hours small-group tour in Port Said, Egypt.

title: Ismailia and the Suez Canal
summary: Ismailia was the base for building the Suez Canal in the 1860s. You visit the little museum, the villa of Ferdinand de Lesseps and a viewpoint where ships pass close enough to wave to the crews.

seo.metaTitle: Ismailia and the Suez Canal | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Watch the ships go by. 6 hours small-group tour in Ismailia, Egypt.

title: Monastery of St Anthony
summary: St Anthony's Monastery in the Eastern Desert is one of the oldest in the world. A monk or guide shows the painted church and spring.

seo.metaTitle: Monastery of St Anthony | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Oldest Christian monastery. 8 hours small-group tour in Red Sea, Egypt.

title: Wadi Natrun Monasteries
summary: The Wadi Natrun valley holds ancient Coptic monasteries founded in the fourth century. You visit two of them, see their churches and fortified towers and talk with a monk about daily life and fasting rules.

seo.metaTitle: Wadi Natrun Monasteries | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Desert monks near Cairo. 8 hours small-group tour in Wadi Natrun, Egypt.

title: Wadi Degla Canyon Hike
summary: Wadi Degla is a protected canyon on Cairo's southeastern edge, with limestone walls, desert plants and fossil shells in the rock. A ranger-guide leads a hike up the wadi, explains the geology and points out gazelle tracks and birds.

seo.metaTitle: Wadi Degla Canyon Hike | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Limestone cliffs ten minutes from the city. 4 hours small-group tour in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Citadel of Saladin and Mohamed Ali Mosque
summary: The Citadel of Saladin is a medieval fortress with the alabaster Mohamed Ali Mosque. A guide explains the dynasties and you look over Cairo from the ramparts.

seo.metaTitle: Citadel of Saladin and Mohamed Ali Mosque | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Cairo**'**s hilltop. 4 hours small-group tour in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Mosque of Ibn Tulun
summary: Ibn Tulun is the oldest mosque in Cairo in its original form, with a vast courtyard and a spiral minaret. You climb the minaret for views.

seo.metaTitle: Mosque of Ibn Tulun | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: The big courtyard. 3 hours small-group tour in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Egyptian Museum Highlights
summary: The old Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square is crowded and wonderfully old-fashioned. A guide picks the pieces that matter, including Tutankhamun's mask, royal mummies and the Amarna room, and steers you around the busiest halls.

seo.metaTitle: Egyptian Museum Highlights | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Tutankhamun and friends. 4 hours small-group tour in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Grand Egyptian Museum
summary: The Grand Egyptian Museum near the pyramids shows thousands of artefacts, including the full Tutankhamun collection. A guide pairs it with a view of the pyramids from its terrace.

seo.metaTitle: Grand Egyptian Museum | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: The new giant museum. 5 hours small-group tour in Giza, Egypt.

title: Garbage City and the Cave Church
summary: Manshiyat Naser is home to Cairo's rubbish collectors, who recycle most of what they gather. A resident guide takes you through the workshops and up to the cave church of St Simon.

seo.metaTitle: Garbage City and the Cave Church | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Cairo**'**s recycling community. 4 hours small-group tour in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Al-Moez Street: Fatimid Cairo, Gate to Gate
summary: Al-Moez Street is lined with mosques, madrasas and gates from the Fatimid era. A guide walks you from Bab al-Futuh to Bab Zuweila, explaining each building and stopping for tea and basbousa at a street stall.

seo.metaTitle: Al-Moez Street: Fatimid Cairo, Gate to Gate | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Islamic Cairo**'**s main street. 4 hours small-group tour in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Nile Dinner Cruise
summary: An evening cruise on the Nile with a buffet dinner and a live music set. You sail past the city bridges and illuminated buildings, with time on deck for photos of the skyline.

seo.metaTitle: Nile Dinner Cruise | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Lights on the water. 3 hours small-group tour in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Zamalek and Gezira Island Walk
summary: Zamalek is a leafy island in the Nile with cafes, galleries and embassies. A local guide takes you through the streets, past a tower with city views.

seo.metaTitle: Zamalek and Gezira Island Walk | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Green island in the city. 3 hours small-group tour in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Heliopolis Belgian Quarter
summary: Heliopolis was a planned suburb built in the early 1900s with a mix of Moorish and Art Nouveau styles. A guide walks you through the Baron Empain Palace and the avenues.

seo.metaTitle: Heliopolis Belgian Quarter | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Art Nouveau in the desert. 4 hours small-group tour in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Minya and Beni Hasan
summary: Beni Hasan has rock-cut tombs with paintings of wrestling and daily life. Nearby Tuna el-Gebel holds a tomb of a priest and thousands of mummified ibises.

seo.metaTitle: Minya and Beni Hasan | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Cliff tombs in Middle Egypt. 2 days small-group tour in Minya, Egypt.

title: Tell el-Amarna: Akhenaten's City
summary: Akhenaten moved Egypt's capital to Amarna and promoted worship of the sun disc, and the experiment lasted barely two decades. A guide takes you across the Nile by ferry and through the rock tombs and royal city ruins.

seo.metaTitle: Tell el-Amarna: Akhenaten's City | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: A short-lived capital. 6 hours small-group tour in Minya, Egypt.

title: Sohag White and Red Monasteries
summary: The White and Red Monasteries near Sohag date from the fifth century. A guide explains their basilica design, the conserved paintings in the Red Monastery and the monastic tradition that still lives on.

seo.metaTitle: Sohag White and Red Monasteries | Egypt
seo.metaDescription: Early Christian architecture. 6 hours small-group tour in Sohag, Egypt.

title: Marsa Matruh Beach Day
summary: Marsa Matruh has some of Egypt's whitest beaches and a turquoise lagoon. A day trip includes a boat to Cleopatra's Bath, a swim, and a seafood lunch in the harbour.

seo.metaTitle: Marsa Matruh Beach Day | Egypt

summary: Saidia has long sand beaches near the Algerian border. You swim, eat grilled sardines and walk the sandy shoreline with a local guide.

title: Berkane Orange Groves

seo.metaDescription: Citrus country. 5 hours small-group tour in Berkane, Morocco.

title: Beni Snassen Gorges

title: Chaouen to Bab Taza Road
summary: The road to Bab Taza winds through Rif cedar forests and villages. A local driver stops at viewpoints and tea houses, and you meet villagers who sell honey and goat cheese.

seo.metaTitle: Chaouen to Bab Taza Road | Morocco

title: Rabat Medina Bookshops
summary: Rabat's medina has old bookshops and the Oudaya garden. A local writer shows you his favourite bookshops and a café where writers meet, and you finish with tea above the Atlantic.

seo.metaDescription: Books beside the Atlantic. 3 hours small-group tour in Rabat, Morocco.

title: Sidi Kaouki Camel Beach
summary: Sidi Kaouki is a surf and kitesurf village south of Essaouira, centred on a whitewashed shrine. You ride a camel along the beach at sunset and eat grilled fish at a beachside restaurant.

summary: Agadir was flattened by an earthquake in 1960 and rebuilt in a modern grid. The ruined kasbah on the hill, Agadir Oufella, is one of the few older remnants. A guide tells the story and you watch the sun set over the bay.

summary: Tiznit is known for Berber silver jewellery, from heavy fibulae to engraved boxes. A silversmith explains the symbols and how the pieces are cast, and shows you how to judge good silver from fake.

seo.metaDescription: Berber jewellery by the weight. 4 hours small-group tour in Tiznit, Morocco.

summary: Chefchaouen's weavers make wool blankets and djellabas on wooden looms. A weaver demonstrates and lets you try a few rows, and explains the patterns used in Rif Mountain weaving.

seo.metaDescription: Looms in the old town. 4 hours small-group tour in Chefchaouen, Morocco.

title: Lixus: Roman Ruins on a Hill
summary: Lixus was a Phoenician and Roman town above the Loukkos River near Larache. A guide leads you through the salting factories, mosaics and theatre, and explains the garum fish sauce trade.

seo.metaDescription: Above the Loukkos River. 5 hours small-group tour in Larache, Morocco.

title: Azemmour Medina by the River
summary: Azemmour sits on the Oum Er-Rbia estuary, with Portuguese walls and a quiet medina. A local artist leads the walk and you see shad fishermen at the river.

seo.metaDescription: Portuguese walls and a quiet river. 4 hours small-group tour in Azemmour, Morocco.

title: Sidi Ifni Art Deco
summary: Sidi Ifni was a Spanish enclave until 1969, and the town has Art Deco buildings and a lighthouse. A guide explains the history and you eat grilled fish at the port.

seo.metaDescription: Spanish enclave by the sea. 4 hours small-group tour in Sidi Ifni, Morocco.

summary: Oukaimeden is North Africa's highest ski resort, an hour and a half from Marrakech. In winter you can slide down its slopes on rented skis, and in summer hike to prehistoric rock engravings along a marked trail, with a local mountain guide.

seo.metaTitle: Oukaimeden Snow and Cairns | Morocco
seo.metaDescription: Skiing and walking in the High Atlas. 8 hours small-group tour in Oukaimeden, Morocco.

title: Stellenbosch Vines by Bicycle
summary: A guide leads a flat-to-rolling ride through the Stellenbosch valley, stopping at two family-run estates for tastings and a vineyard picnic. You learn what grows where and why Pinotage was created here, and a support van carries the wine.

seo.metaTitle: Stellenbosch Vines by Bicycle | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: Pedal between tasting rooms, carefully. 7 hours small-group tour in Stellenbosch, South Africa.

title: Franschhoek Cap Classique and Cheese
summary: Franschhoek was settled by French Huguenots in the 1680s and still has Cape Dutch farmhouses and tidy vineyards. You taste Cap Classique sparkling wine, visit a cheesemaker and walk the main street's galleries.

seo.metaDescription: Bubbles in a French-Huguenot valley. 6 hours small-group tour in Franschhoek, South Africa.

title: Paarl Rock Sunrise Walk
summary: Paarl Mountain is a cluster of giant granite domes above the Cape winelands. A guide leads the early walk through fynbos, explains the plants and finishes with coffee at the Afrikaans Language Monument.

seo.metaTitle: Paarl Rock Sunrise Walk | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: Granite domes, fynbos and a long view. 4 hours small-group tour in Paarl, South Africa.

title: Wellington Wagon Trail
summary: Wellington is a quiet valley where early wagon routes crossed the Bainskloof pass. A guide drives the pass, stops at a Cape Dutch farmstead for lunch and tells the story of the road builders.

seo.metaTitle: Wellington Wagon Trail | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: Cape Dutch farms and a mountain pass. 6 hours small-group tour in Wellington, South Africa.

title: Hermanus Whale Season Cliff Path
summary: From June to November, southern right whales calve in Walker Bay. A guide walks the cliff path with binoculars, explains how whale callers once signalled sightings and stops for fish at the old harbour.

seo.metaTitle: Hermanus Whale Season Cliff Path | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: Southern rights close to shore. 4 hours small-group tour in Hermanus, South Africa.

summary: Dyer Island and Shark Alley are home to Cape fur seals and great white sharks. A marine biologist briefs you before the boat trip and you can go into the cage if you wish.

seo.metaDescription: Face to face with a great white. 5 hours small-group tour in Gansbaai, South Africa.

summary: Stony Point has a breeding colony of African penguins in a setting that is much quieter than the famous Cape Town colony. A ranger explains nesting and conservation, and you walk the boardwalk.

seo.metaTitle: Betty's Bay Penguin Colony | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: African penguins on a quiet beach. 4 hours small-group tour in Betty's Bay, South Africa.

title: Land's End, Africa Style: Cape Agulhas
summary: At Cape Agulhas a stone marker shows where the Atlantic and Indian oceans officially meet. You climb the lighthouse, one of the oldest working in the country, walk the shipwreck-strewn limestone coast and eat fresh fish at the village restaurant.

seo.metaTitle: Land's End, Africa Style: Cape Agulhas | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: Where two oceans technically meet. 8 hours small-group tour in Cape Agulhas, South Africa.

summary: Route 62 threads through Karoo towns, orchards and mountain passes. Over two days you stop at a farm stall for fruit brandy, a roadside pub in Barrydale and an old inn, sleeping in a restored farmhouse.

seo.metaDescription: Roadside pies and mountain passes. 2 days small-group tour in Montagu, South Africa.

summary: The Cango Caves are limestone chambers beneath the Swartberg. The adventure route squeezes through narrow tunnels, then an ostrich farm shows how the feather boom of the 1900s made Oudtshoorn rich.

seo.metaTitle: Cango Caves and a Very Large Bird | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: Underground chambers and big birds. 7 hours small-group tour in Oudtshoorn, South Africa.

seo.metaDescription: Dirt road in the clouds. 6 hours small-group tour in Prince Albert, South Africa.

title: Knysna Heads and an Oyster at Eye Level

seo.metaTitle: Knysna Heads and an Oyster at Eye Level | South Africa

title: Looking for Knysna's Last Elephants

seo.metaDescription: The last of the Knysna elephants. 5 hours small-group tour in Knysna, South Africa.

summary: A short coastal trail leads from the rest camp to a suspension bridge over the river mouth, where the Indian Ocean crashes against dark rocks. A ranger points out birds and sea cliffs.

seo.metaDescription: Walk to the sea. 3 hours small-group tour in Tsitsikamma, South Africa.

seo.metaTitle: Robberg Peninsula Circuit | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: Seal colony and sea cliffs. 4 hours small-group tour in Plettenberg Bay, South Africa.

summary: Addo Elephant National Park holds over 600 elephants, as well as lions and rhinos. You drive at dawn with a ranger and stop at a waterhole where herds drink and play.

seo.metaTitle: Addo at Sunrise: Elephants Close Up | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: Hundreds in the open. 2 days small-group tour in Addo, South Africa.

title: Baviaanskloof Backroads

seo.metaTitle: Baviaanskloof Backroads | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: A valley few people know. 3 days small-group tour in Baviaanskloof, South Africa.

title: Valley of Desolation at Sunset

seo.metaTitle: Valley of Desolation at Sunset | South Africa
seo.metaDescription: Dolerite pillars above the Karoo. 5 hours small-group tour in Graaff-Reinet, South Africa.

summary: Hogsback sits in a forested mountain range in the Eastern Cape, often wrapped in mist. You walk to Madonna and Child Falls and Armstrong Falls and among ancient yellowwoods, in a village that readers say inspired Tolkien.

summary: Constitution Hill was a prison where Gandhi and Mandela were held, and now houses the Constitutional Court. A guide shows the cells, the Old Fort and the court's art collection.

seo.metaDescription: On foot with a ranger. 2 days small-group tour in Kruger, South Africa.

title: Blyde River Canyon Viewpoints
summary: Blyde River Canyon is one of the largest green canyons in the world. You visit the Three Rondavels, God's Window and Bourke's Luck Potholes with a guide who explains the geology and local legends.

summary: Lake Fundudzi is sacred to the Venda people and is surrounded by a protected forest. A cultural guide arranges respectful viewing, explains the python legend and visits the Thathe Vondo forest.

summary: The Big Hole in Kimberley was dug by hand during the diamond rush of the 1870s. A guide tours the Kimberley Mine Museum, the reconstructed old town and the viewing platform over the pit.

seo.metaTitle: Kimberley's Big Hole | South Africa

title: Kgalagadi: Red Dunes, Black-Maned Lions
summary: The Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park has red dunes, dry riverbeds and black-maned lions. You camp and drive the riverbeds with a guide, looking for gemsbok, springbok and raptors.

title: Namaqualand in Bloom

seo.metaDescription: Daisies in August. 2 days small-group tour in Namaqualand, South Africa.
